metadata.case_name: LO PING KIN v. YUEN TSZ SHING T/A WING TAO PROFESSIONAL RECYCLE

injuries.description: Big toe: open fracture of distal phalanx with nail bed laceration and nail place detachment; Second toe: subluxation of proximal interphalangeal joint (PIPJ); 3rd, 4th and 5th toes: fracture at shafts of proximal phalanges.
source:
(a) The plaintiff was admitted to the hospital’s accident and emergency department on 22 January 2011 after his right foot was crushed resulting in

(i) Big toe: open fracture of distal phalanx with nail bed laceration and
nail place detachment;

(ii) Second toe: subluxation of proximal interphalangeal joint (PIPJ); and

(iii) 3rd, 4th and 5th toes: fracture at shafts of proximal phalanges.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

manifestations.description: Mild residual pain and stiffness in right foot
Numbness and pain in right foot from time to time
Unable to work; unemployed since the accident

treatments_received.treatment: Wound debridement, operative reduction and fixation, nail bed repair
source: (b) Wound debridement, operative reduction and fixation, nail bed repair were performed on the same day. He started on non-weight bearing walking post-operatively and was discharged on 25 January 2011 with physiotherapist arranged.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for clavicle / hand / foot (except carpal / talus / calcaneus) +/- internal fixation

source: (b) Wound debridement, operative reduction and fixation, nail bed repair were performed on the same day. He started on non-weight bearing walking post-operatively and was discharged on 25 January 2011 with physiotherapist arranged.

treatments_received.treatment: Removal of metal wire at 8th week
source: (c) Upon follow-up at the specialist out-patient clinic, his condition improved with decrease in pain. The metal wire was removed at the 8th week. X-ray showed fracture union.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Removal of screw, pin and plate, and other metal for old fracture except fracture femur

source: (b) Wound debridement, operative reduction and fixation, nail bed repair were performed on the same day. He started on non-weight bearing walking post-operatively and was discharged on 25 January 2011 with physiotherapist arranged.

treatments_future.treatment: See a bone setter (鐵打) and buy ointment to soothe his pain
source: The plaintiff testified that he still suffers from foot pain and numbness from time to time and that he is required to see a bone setter (鐵打) and to buy ointment to sooth his pain.

losses.description: Pain, numbness and mild residual pain and stiffness in right foot
Has been unable to work since the accident; unemployed until trial; difficulty operating industrial vehicles due to foot injury
